about: How Outrigger treats each FM-1 firmware family, keyed by mutant.cloud firmware.json's `base`. Reviewed by hand: a listing's base is self-serve on mutant.cloud, so ids here override it. docs/firmware-catalog.md explains the groups.

blocked_ids.melodee: writes the FM-1's Bluetooth sector (listed as built on Felucca)
blocked_ids.vector37: built on Felucca 0.9 (mutant.cloud says its own code)
blocked_ids.gator: built on Felucca 0.9 (mutant.cloud says its own code)
blocked_ids.mycelium: built on Felucca 0.9 (the Hub says Felucca and SLOOP; mutant.cloud says Felucca)
